# lv_font_conv

Vendored npm tarball for the firmware Hermit package `lv_font_conv@1.5.3`.

The firmware build uses this tool to convert display fonts into LVGL C sources. Public npm is not reachable from Block CI, and Block Artifactory is not reachable from GitHub-hosted Actions runners, so the tarball is stored in-repo for deterministic CI builds.

The tarball preserves the npm `package/` layout and includes bundled runtime npm dependencies plus the upstream MIT license.
